name: craftedeffects-tests
description: GameTests for CraftedEffects, run on a real Bedrock Dedicated Server via bds-runner

scripts.test: npm run --silent test:shipped && npm run --silent test:gametests
scripts.test:shipped: bc-bds run --packs ../behavior_pack --packs ../resource_pack --packs gametest_pack --tag smoke --expect-registered 1 --json .bds/result-shipped.json; status=$?; python3 tools/check_log.py || exit 1; exit $status
scripts.test:gametests: bc-bds run --packs .build/behavior_pack --packs ../resource_pack --packs gametest_pack --tag craftedeffects --expect-registered 6 --json .bds/result.json; status=$?; python3 tools/check_log.py || exit 1; exit $status
